description: Use this when the user wants their own version of a static (image) ad they like, a competitor's or any reference. It rebuilds it on-brand: SAME layout, composition and energy, but the user's product, brand colours, logo and voice, with every trace of the source brand removed. Pass `imageUrl` = the static ad image to clone. Uses the saved brand (brandId picks another profile, like use_brand). IMAGES ONLY — for a video ad use clone_video with its link, then render_ad. Bills as one image generation.

brandId.description: a profile id/name from list_brands to clone for; omit to use the active profile

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

imageUrl.description: the URL of the static ad image to clone. Using a real person’s face, likeness or voice confirms you are them or have their consent, take full, unlimited responsibility for its use and will cover any claim against Hermoso (hermoso.ai/terms). Paid plan only; recorded.

name: clone_static
title: Clone a static ad
